sections.heading: Plot
sections.wikitext:
;Preparations Inside [[Dante Vale's house|Dante's house]], he tells himself the story of how in ancient times, the Nullifiers were called to Earth, and how everyone is coming to terms with this being the night that the Spirals could reactivate the mark. [[Sophie Casterwill|Sophie]] and [[Dante Vale|Dante]] talk to the [[Huntik Foundation]] council via a video call and reassure them that they will receive the location of the Spiral Mark from [[Zhalia Moon|Zhalia]] soon. The [[Blood Spiral]] is also preparing for tonight, as Rassimov holds an audience with the [[Blooded Circle]] as they discuss how the [[Casterwill family]] will try and stop them, this time with a ghost-like form of [[the Betrayer]] arising to give orders. Rassimov sends [[Marduk]] to destroy [[Sophie]]. [[Eathon]], through the [[Holotome]], tells Lok and the team that the last quatrain is located at [[Nostradamus]]'s tomb which is hidden in a forest south of [[Salon Graveyard]]. A notable feature includes a tree with red leaves. ;Arrival in Salon [[File:S2E49 Casterwill Hunter Dante plane wreckage.png|thumb|[[Dante Vale|Dante]] fights a [[Casterwill Hunters|Casterwill Hunter]] by the [[Huntik Foundation jet|plane]]'s wreckage]] The Huntik plane lands but is attacked by [[Casterwill Hunters]]. Surprised by this new ambush, the team take cover inside the plane. This does not stop the Casterwill Hunters. One of them invokes [[Psikofen]] who uses his chains to cut through the plane and tear it apart. The team jump out as the plane explodes. Lok summons [[Ironsquire]] who fights Psikofen but loses his shield in the confrontation. [[Den]] and [[Dante]] brawl with the Casterwill Hunters. [[Sophie]] invokes [[Kelpie]] who knocks out a Casterwill hunter. Kelpie gets entangled along with Ironsquire in Psikofen's ruthless chains. Cherit, noticing Psikofen slowing down, defeats him with his energy charge. Realizing they must hurry, the team quickly move out. In the meantime, the [[Huntik Foundation Council]] decide to deploy their [[Seeker]]s out in their [[Scramjet]]s but giving [[Casterwill family|Casterwills]] priority. They have six to twelve hours of daylight left, depending on where in the world it is. In the [[Blood Spiral Base]], [[Rassimov]] begins to activate the [[Spiral Mark]] starting with magical rituals ;Nostradamus's Tomb The team arrive at the graveyard where Nostradamus is believed to be buried. However, there are myriads of trees with red leaves that match Eathon's description. Lok, frustrated, accidentally lands the [[Willblade]] in a random area of ground. To his amazement, flights of stairs come out of the ground, and even more astonishingly, they all lead to the tomb. Now realizing that Nostradamus had wanted them never to miss it, the team enter the tomb and uncover the last quatrain, which reads: 
  ''Into the Spiral center,'' 
  ''A champion of the family will fly.''
  ''Only the fire of justice'' 
  ''Will cause the long night to die.'' [[File:S2E49 Helinx Dante.png|thumb|[[Helinx]] attacks [[Dante Vale|Dante]] in [[Nostradamus]]' Tomb]] In meanwhile, [[Marduk]] and the [[Casterwill Hunters]] wait outside, determined not to let them escape again. The team deduce that the "fire of justice" must be the [[Phoenix]] and the "family" must be the [[Casterwill family]]. After finding a clock face at the back of the scroll, they realize that Nostradamus knew exactly when they would arrive. Marduk then surprises them with a sudden attack. The team quickly head for the stairs to get out of their vulnerable position in a corner. Den invokes [[Dullahan]] while Dante summons [[Elf King Oberon]]. The two Titans fight against Psikofen and Marduk's agile cat Titan, [[Helinx]]. Dante and Lok head out to the open with Marduk on their trail. Dante gets a message from [[Zhalia Moon]] and leaves Lok to cover him who finds himself face-to-face with Marduk's Psikofen. ;The Location [[File:S2E49 Sophie Dante Logosbook Cypherdex.png|thumb|[[Sophie Casterwill|Sophie]] and [[Dante Vale|Dante]] rush to tell [[Metz]] after [[Zhalia Moon|Zhalia]] informed them of the [[Spiral Mark]]'s location]] In the Spiral Mark, Rassimov invokes the Nullifier [[Void]] to finally reveal the Spiral Mark, and Zhalia desperately tries to send the coordinates to Dante. Back in the tomb, Lok invokes [[Baselaird|Powerbonded Baselaird]] to take on Psikofen. After a hasty battle, Baselaird defeats Psikofen who returns to his amulet in Marduk's hand. Oberon defeats Helinx with an energy sphere while Sophie, Den and Cherit join Dante, who transfers the coordinates to the [[Huntik Foundation]]. Determined not to waste any time, Dante calls [[Umbra]], who teleports the whole team to the Spiral Mark while Marduk screams in anger. By the Spiral Mark, Dante declares that they have a world to save.

sections.wikitext:
* In real life, the longest night of the year is called the [[wikipedia:Winter solstice|Winter solstice]].
* Sophie declares that they have never been attacked before getting off the plane, even though they were in fact attacked multiple times by [[the Organization]] before landing, such as in "[[The Bookshop Hunter]]" or "[[The Power of Umbra]]".

full_text:
After being defeated by Rassimov, the Huntik team rests at Lok's mother's house. They end up helping Scarlet with a mission to Tír na nÓg, and Lok falls into a gap between dimensions. There, he is able to talk with his father, Eathon, who helps him finally bond with the Titan in the Willblade, Pendragon.

== Synopsis ==
The final battle shapes up as the longest night of the year begins. Lok, Dante, Sophie and Den head to the tomb of Nostradamus to find his last Quatrain. As they await Zhalia's signal, it is a race against time to get to the Spiral Mark.

== Plot ==
;Preparations
Inside Dante's house, he tells himself the story of how in ancient times, the Nullifiers were called to Earth, and how everyone is coming to terms with this being the night that the Spirals could reactivate the mark. Sophie and Dante talk to the Huntik Foundation council via a video call and reassure them that they will receive the location of the Spiral Mark from Zhalia soon. The Blood Spiral is also preparing for tonight, as Rassimov holds an audience with the Blooded Circle as they discuss how the Casterwill family will try and stop them, this time with a ghost-like form of the Betrayer arising to give orders. Rassimov sends Marduk to destroy Sophie. Eathon, through the Holotome, tells Lok and the team that the last quatrain is located at Nostradamus's tomb which is hidden in a forest south of Salon Graveyard. A notable feature includes a tree with red leaves. 

;Arrival in Salon
 fights a Casterwill Hunter by the plane's wreckage]]
The Huntik plane lands but is attacked by Casterwill Hunters. Surprised by this new ambush, the team take cover inside the plane. This does not stop the Casterwill Hunters. One of them invokes Psikofen who uses his chains to cut through the plane and tear it apart. The team jump out as the plane explodes. Lok summons Ironsquire who fights Psikofen but loses his shield in the confrontation. Den and Dante brawl with the Casterwill Hunters. Sophie invokes Kelpie who knocks out a Casterwill hunter. Kelpie gets entangled along with Ironsquire in Psikofen's ruthless chains. Cherit, noticing Psikofen slowing down, defeats him with his energy charge. Realizing they must hurry, the team quickly move out. In the meantime, the Huntik Foundation Council decide to deploy their Seekers out in their Scramjets but giving Casterwills priority. They have six to twelve hours of daylight left, depending on where in the world it is. In the Blood Spiral Base, Rassimov begins to activate the Spiral Mark starting with magical rituals

;Nostradamus's Tomb
The team arrive at the graveyard where Nostradamus is believed to be buried. However, there are myriads of trees with red leaves that match Eathon's description. Lok, frustrated, accidentally lands the Willblade in a random area of ground. To his amazement, flights of stairs come out of the ground, and even more astonishingly, they all lead to the tomb. Now realizing that Nostradamus had wanted them never to miss it, the team enter the tomb and uncover the last quatrain, which reads: 

 
Into the Spiral center, 
 
A champion of the family will fly. 
 
Only the fire of justice 
 
Will cause the long night to die.
 attacks Dante in Nostradamus' Tomb]]
In meanwhile, Marduk and the Casterwill Hunters wait outside, determined not to let them escape again. The team deduce that the "fire of justice" must be the Phoenix and the "family" must be the Casterwill family. After finding a clock face at the back of the scroll, they realize that Nostradamus knew exactly when they would arrive. Marduk then surprises them with a sudden attack. The team quickly head for the stairs to get out of their vulnerable position in a corner. Den invokes Dullahan while Dante summons Elf King Oberon. The two Titans fight against Psikofen and Marduk's agile cat Titan, Helinx. Dante and Lok head out to the open with Marduk on their trail. Dante gets a message from Zhalia Moon and leaves Lok to cover him who finds himself face-to-face with Marduk's Psikofen.

;The Location
 and Dante rush to tell Metz after Zhalia informed them of the Spiral Mark's location]]
In the Spiral Mark, Rassimov invokes the Nullifier Void to finally reveal the Spiral Mark, and Zhalia desperately tries to send the coordinates to Dante. Back in the tomb, Lok invokes Powerbonded Baselaird to take on Psikofen. After a hasty battle, Baselaird defeats Psikofen who returns to his amulet in Marduk's hand. Oberon defeats Helinx with an energy sphere while Sophie, Den and Cherit join Dante, who transfers the coordinates to the Huntik Foundation. Determined not to waste any time, Dante calls Umbra, who teleports the whole team to the Spiral Mark while Marduk screams in anger. By the Spiral Mark, Dante declares that they have a world to save.

[[Sophie Casterwill|Sophie]] and [[Dante Vale|Dante]] talk to the [[Huntik Foundation]] council via a video call and reassure them that they will receive the location of the Spiral Mark from [[Zhalia Moon|Zhalia]] soon. The [[Blood Spiral]] is also preparing for tonight, as Rassimov holds an audience with the [[Blooded Circle]] as they discuss how the [[Casterwill family]] will try and stop them, this time with a ghost-like form of [[the Betrayer]] arising to give orders. Rassimov sends [[Marduk]] to destroy [[Sophie]]. [[Eathon]], through the [[Holotome]], tells Lok and the team that the last quatrain is located at [[Nostradamus]]'s tomb which is hidden in a forest south of [[Salon Graveyard]]. A notable feature includes a tree with red leaves. ;Arrival in Salon [[File:S2E49 Casterwill Hunter Dante plane wreckage.png|thumb|[[Dante Vale|Dante]] fights a [[Casterwill Hunters|Casterwill Hunter]] by the [[Huntik Foundation jet|plane]]'s wreckage]] The Huntik plane lands but is attacked by [[Casterwill Hunters]]. Surprised by this new ambush, the team take cover inside the plane. This does not stop the Casterwill Hunters. One of them invokes [[Psikofen]] who uses his chains to cut through the plane and tear it apart. The team jump out as the plane explodes. Lok summons [[Ironsquire]] who fights Psikofen but loses his shield in the confrontation. [[Den]] and [[Dante]] brawl with the Casterwill Hunters. [[Sophie]] invokes [[Kelpie]] who knocks out a Casterwill hunter. Kelpie gets entangled along with Ironsquire in Psikofen's ruthless chains. Cherit, noticing Psikofen slowing down, defeats him with his energy charge. Realizing they must hurry, the team quickly move out. In the meantime, the [[Huntik Foundation Council]] decide to deploy their [[Seeker]]s out in their [[Scramjet]]s but giving [[Casterwill family|Casterwills]] priority. They have six to twelve hours of daylight left, depending on where in the world it is. In the [[Blood Spiral Base]], [[Rassimov]] begins to activate the [[Spiral Mark]] starting with magical rituals ;Nostradamus's Tomb The team arrive at the graveyard where Nostradamus is believed to be buried. However, there are myriads of trees with red leaves that match Eathon's description. Lok, frustrated, accidentally lands the [[Willblade]] in a random area of ground. To his amazement, flights of stairs come out of the ground, and even more astonishingly, they all lead to the tomb. Now realizing that Nostradamus had wanted them never to miss it, the team enter the tomb and uncover the last quatrain, which reads: 
  ''Into the Spiral center,'' 
  ''A champion of the family will fly.''
  ''Only the fire of justice'' 
  ''Will cause the long night to die.'' [[File:S2E49 Helinx Dante.png|thumb|[[Helinx]] attacks [[Dante Vale|Dante]] in [[Nostradamus]]' Tomb]] In meanwhile, [[Marduk]] and the [[Casterwill Hunters]] wait outside, determined not to let them escape again. The team deduce that the "fire of justice" must be the [[Phoenix]] and the "family" must be the [[Casterwill family]]. After finding a clock face at the back of the scroll, they realize that Nostradamus knew exactly when they would arrive. Marduk then surprises them with a sudden attack. The team quickly head for the stairs to get out of their vulnerable position in a corner. Den invokes [[Dullahan]] while Dante summons [[Elf King Oberon]]. The two Titans fight against Psikofen and Marduk's agile cat Titan, [[Helinx]]. Dante and Lok head out to the open with Marduk on their trail. Dante gets a message from [[Zhalia Moon]] and leaves Lok to cover him who finds himself face-to-face with Marduk's Psikofen. ;The Location [[File:S2E49 Sophie Dante Logosbook Cypherdex.png|thumb|[[Sophie Casterwill|Sophie]] and [[Dante Vale|Dante]] rush to tell [[Metz]] after [[Zhalia Moon|Zhalia]] informed them of the [[Spiral Mark]]'s location]] In the Spiral Mark, Rassimov invokes the Nullifier [[Void]] to finally reveal the Spiral Mark, and Zhalia desperately tries to send the coordinates to Dante. Back in the tomb, Lok invokes [[Baselaird|Powerbonded Baselaird]] to take on Psikofen. After a hasty battle, Baselaird defeats Psikofen who returns to his amulet in Marduk's hand. Oberon defeats Helinx with an energy sphere while Sophie, Den and Cherit join Dante, who transfers the coordinates to the [[Huntik Foundation]]. Determined not to waste any time, Dante calls [[Umbra]], who teleports the whole team to the Spiral Mark while Marduk screams in anger. By the Spiral Mark, Dante declares that they have a world to save.
